info.name: Player Service
info.description:
Postman Collection for testing Player Service: authentication, profile, XP progression, inventory, achievements and atomic trades.

Run the collection in order - requests share state through collection variables. Usernames are randomised per run, so it can be run repeatedly without resetting the database.

Start the service first (see player-service/README.md). Default baseUrl is http://localhost:8000, the Gateway, which forwards /api/auth, /api/players and /api/trades to Player Service.
